components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:3px;background:var(--sidebar,#dbe6ca);padding:10px}.ds-nav button{font:400 15px/1.5 var(--ui-font,"Pixelify Sans",sans-serif);text-align:left;padding:12px 14px;min-height:43px;color:var(--muted,#445540);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;background:none}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#dbe6ca;color:var(--ink,#1c3422)}.ds-nav [aria-current=page]{background:var(--accent-pale,#f8d9af);color:var(--accent,#9e2e21);border-color:var(--ink,#1c3422);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--accent,#9e2e21)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#9e2e21);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-cloud{position:relative;margin:8px 10px 20px;padding:12px;border:3px solid var(--ink,#1c3422);border-radius:0;background:var(--surface,#fff8e6);color:var(--ink,#1c3422);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px var(--surface,#fff8e6),inset 0 0 0 4px var(--line,#a7b395),0 4px 12px #152b2122}.ds-cloud p{font:14px/1.65 var(--body-font,Inter,sans-serif)}.ds-cloud button{font:10px/1.5 var(--ui-font,"Pixelify Sans",sans-serif);border:0;border-radius:0;background:var(--accent,#9e2e21);color:var(--on-accent,#fff8e6);padding:6px 7px;min-height:30px}.ds-cloud button:hover{background:var(--accent-hover,#7c1e14)}.ds-cloud button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#9e2e21);outline-offset:3px}.ds-cloud i{position:absolute;bottom:-12px;left:calc(50% - 9px);width:18px;height:12px;background:var(--surface,#fff8e6);border:3px solid var(--ink,#1c3422);border-top:0}.ds-cloud i:after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-6px;left:3px;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--ink,#1c3422)}

components.css: .ds-stops{display:flex;gap:28px;background:#faf0d6;padding:12px}.ds-stops button{display:grid;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;color:#596046;font:10px/1.5 var(--ui-font,"Pixelify Sans",sans-serif);text-align:left;padding:0}.ds-stops span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:24px;height:24px;border:2px solid #8b9677;background:#faf0d6;color:#203d2d}.ds-stops [aria-current=step]{color:#a83e29}.ds-stops [aria-current=step] span{background:#a83e29;border-color:#a83e29;color:#faf0d6}.ds-stops button:hover span{border-color:#a83e29}.ds-stops button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a83e29;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Pet selector
components.description: Hover or keyboard focus reveals a three-icon semicircle above Pace; no labels beneath the pet.
components.css: .ds-pet-actions{position:relative;width:224px;height:224px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center}.ds-pet-focus{border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink,#1c3422);font:16px/1.4 var(--ui-font,"Pixelify Sans",sans-serif);padding:35px}.ds-selector{position:absolute;top:4px;left:4px;right:4px;height:94px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),visibility 120ms}.ds-pet-actions:hover .ds-selector,.ds-pet-actions:focus-within .ds-selector{opacity:1;visibility:visible}.ds-selector button{position:absolute;left:calc((100% - 32px)*var(--slot));top:var(--arc);display:grid;place-items:center;width:32px;height:32px;padding:0;border:2px solid var(--ink,#1c3422);border-radius:0;background:var(--surface,#fff8e6);color:var(--ink,#1c3422);box-shadow:0 2px 4px #152b2122;transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-selector button:hover,.ds-selector button:focus-visible{background:var(--accent,#9e2e21);color:var(--on-accent,#fff8e6);transform:scale(1.12)}.ds-selector button:hover+button,.ds-selector button:has(+button:hover){transform:scale(1.04)}.ds-pet-actions button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#9e2e21);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-selector,.ds-selector button{transition:none;transform:none!important}}

narrative.northStar: A calm workspace for a playful little companion.
narrative.overview:
Pace brings the play; the interface makes room for the task. The user’s GBA/8-bit direction spans the native desktop pet, speech clouds, campsite introduction and supporting workspace. Square controls, crisp outlines and the original yellow cheetah share one world.

Three selected palettes change the scenery: Camp, Night and Handheld. Bundled Pixelify Sans gives short headings and controls their game character; Inter keeps prose comfortable to read. The companion’s authored poses remain the focal art. Setup, settings and longer records open through explicit workspace actions.
keyCharacteristics: One pixel world across the app
Three palettes with semantic color roles
Original sprite identity and calibrated new poses

rules.name: The One World Rule
rules.body: Carry the pixel vocabulary through the companion and workspace; the campsite is an expression of the shared world, not its boundary.

rules.name: The Readable Prose Rule
rules.body: Use the selected interface face for short headings and controls; keep editable text, explanations and transcripts in the selected body face.

rules.name: The Honest State Rule
rules.body: A pose, progress indicator or ready label must follow the actual operation; a preview never implies an insertion happened.

dos: Do preserve the original Pace artwork, colors and authored timing.
Do use the selected palette’s semantic roles across the workspace and clouds.
Do keep generated prose scrollable, selectable and reviewable.
Do preserve keyboard focus, accessible names and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show real model, permission, recording and insertion states.
donts: Don’t put pixel lettering in long editable prose or transcripts.
Don’t fabricate replies, transcripts, download completion or capture success.
Don’t place persistent labels or a tool strip beneath Pace.
Keep deferred writing controls and shortcut bindings out of current product flows.
Don’t promise universal screen-capture exclusion or continuous background autocomplete.
